relation: subgraph_of H G <-> has_subgraph G H (has_subgraphP), unconditional; host first.
summary: Batch A, family A5 (ordinary subgraph containment). Seven conjecture-local helpers (X31, chromatic XE1, X59, X78, extremal XE1, U13, misc XE2), all an injective adjacency-preserving map from the pattern into the host (U13 through `is_hom`), now unfold to `GTBase.common.has_subgraph G H`, HOST FIRST, the reverse of their `(H G)` argument order. `has_subgraphP` proves the unconditional witness characterization (upstream `hom_s`'s image-distinctness premise is discharged by injectivity and irreflexivity); the canonical is not convertible to the local conjunction. No inducedness, nonemptiness or degree guard is added. Thirty-five statements are affected; each frozen statement goes through frozen copies along its whole affected chain, including the six extremal XE1 chains (Ramsey, diagonal Ramsey, C4-forcing degree, Turan number, minimal Turan) and the cross-module rows (chromatic and extremal XE2, X96, X98). Certificates transport the helper iff through the unchanged statements by axiom-free setoid rewriting. X98's subdivision Record was frozen by B3; B3's statement snapshot still calls the live helper and is documented below, and `X98Original` combines B3's frozen Record with this family's frozen helper. M1 edge/count aliases in these rows stay live, so no row is claimed to be pre-M1.

Proof consumers rebuilt with unchanged statements: GTMisc.grounding_U13.subgraph_of_refl and Atlas e117 (implications_A1), both through `has_subgraphP`. No statement text, doc block, manifest row, leg state or documented discrepancy changes.

B4 history (follow-up): B4 (fbf33a0) also freezes chromatic erdos_1091 and extremal erdos_567. Each family's snapshot keeps the other's live helper and is documented in the other's spec; XE2Original.erdos_1091_statement and XE1Original.erdos_567_statement combine both families' frozen chains. No earlier frozen body changes.
